title: Android design proposal
description: A proposal file: a navigation graph of screens, each an A2UI v1.0 createSurface body against the m3-expressive catalog. The component definitions below are generated from the same registry as m3-expressive.catalog.json.

Theme.description: Overrides DESIGN.md front matter; same keys, merged per key.

start.description: The screen the proposal opens on.

panes.description: Screen id to pane role; unlisted screens are a single pane.

Screen.description: The body of an A2UI createSurface message.

components.description: A flat list with exactly one component whose id is root.

Action.description: A renderer-side function call. Event actions are not supported.

showIn.description: Size classes the component shows in; all by default.

sizeClass.description: Prop overrides per size class (medium 600 to 839 dp, expanded 840 dp and up).

weight.description: Relative weight inside a Row or Column. Must be a number from 0.01 to 100.

padding.description: Padding around the component. A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

ComponentId.description: A component id, unique within its screen.

Child.description: A reference to one component by id.

oneOf.description: A template repeated for each item of a data model list.

ShapeValue.description: A corner token or a MaterialShapes polygon.

spacing.description: Gap between children (Arrangement.spacedBy). A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

component.Box.description: Stacks children on top of each other.

component.Grid.description: Lays children out in a grid with a column count or a minimum column width.

columns.description: Fixed column count. Must be a whole number from 1 to 24.

minColumnWidth.description: Minimum column width in dp; columns fill the width. Must be a number from 1 to 1000.

spacing.description: Gap between cells. A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

component.FlexBox.description: Lays children out in a row that wraps.

gap.description: A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

width.description: A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

height.description: A name from the design system's spacing scale (default: none, xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xxxl).

component.Shape.description: Clips its child to a MaterialShapes polygon.

component.Text.description: A run of text in a type role.

maxLines.description: Must be a whole number from 1 to 100.

component.Icon.description: A Material Symbols icon (Rounded, weight 400, grade 0).

size.description: Size in dp; 24 by default. Must be a number from 1 to 512.

component.Image.description: A bitmap from a file next to the proposal or a data URI.

src.description: Path relative to the proposal, or a data: URI.

aspectRatio.description: Width divided by height. Must be a number from 0.1 to 10.

component.Scaffold.description: The screen frame: bars, floating action button and content.
